completion_data.completion_summary: Ran the CSLib vetting pipeline against the refactored modal-tableau subsystem as the programme's terminal acceptance gate. Live re-measurement (Phase 1) confirmed nine documentation-accuracy defects plus two undiscovered axiom-census word-count drifts, all corrected in Phases 2-3 (S4 module count eleven->ten across three deliverable files; six drifted README.md numeric figures; two self-flagged stale FrameSoundness/FrameCompleteness sizes refreshed; the volatile repo-wide ModalTableauResult span command rescoped away from scanning specs/). Phase 4 re-recorded the s4witness.lean out-of-tree probe verdict additively, with the box-plus birth-key enrichment attribution (three commits, all dated 2026-08-05, confirmed by git merge-base to predate the programme's own commits) fully explaining all three observed divergences -- no unexplained residual, so the finding stayed non-blocking under the acceptance-gate decision rule. Phase 5 re-ran the full CI gate post-fix: all eleven blocking criteria green (build 3323 jobs, checkInitImports, lint-style, test, mk_all, shake residue, all four pre-pr-check ratchets, axiom-level behaviour preservation on the capstone and all six Decidable instances). Phase 6 emitted the formal verdict PASS WITH FIX TASKS with the full blocking/non-blocking criteria tables, decision rule, remediation ledger, and three roadmap items for out-of-scope remediation. Zero .lean proof terms touched; every edit confined to docstrings, README prose, and a specs-tree report.
roadmap_items: Retarget stale out-of-tree probe artifact records: annotate the S4 loop-guard report 01's s4probe.lean harness description as describing a superseded revision of the file (eight identifiers it names -- dfsR, classify, statsL, badL, hasCountermodel, notS4Valid, def sat, def isS4 -- have zero matches in the current on-disk file), and replace s4subtractive3.lean's pre-split LoopChecking.lean:NNNN line citations with declaration names (the declarations still exist under the same names in S4/Hintikka.lean, S4/HintikkaInvariant.lean, S4/Driver.lean -- only the file:line citations are wrong).

Repo-wide unusedArguments lint hygiene: 145 sites across 27 modules (10 in Modal/Tableau/); uniform pattern is an unused [Hashable Atom] (or analogous) section-level instance binder; idiomatic fix is `omit [Hashable Atom] in` before the affected block.

Re-establish the six expensive out-of-tree probe verdicts (s4probe.lean, s4boxed.lean, s4ancestor.lean, s4subtractive.lean, s4subtractive2.lean, s4subtractive3.lean) under a dedicated multi-hour budget.
